novelty_review.scope: Internal engineering review for native validation; not external acceptance
novelty_review.rationale: The cooling shroud blocks storage removal, storage enters through capped rails, keyed cooler feet occupy a different interface, and lid closure retains the cooler. Correct replacement identities and collection of both removed parts are required.
novelty_review.risk: Moderate maintenance overlap; dependencies must be physical rather than enforced solely by a scripted order. Native obstruction and retention probes are required.

review_notes: Passive mechanics, source-defined contact geometry, measured-state controller and native probes implemented. Offline geometry cannot establish physical success. No task may enter the submission handoff before runtime evidence passes.

official_review.reason: Importance and construct validity: generic gravity cooler and connector-free storage.
replacement_requirements: Choose one exact equipment model and real procedure; do not combine unrelated service manuals into invented hardware.
Model its actual retention, release, electrical/mechanical connector and handling interfaces.
Dell examples expose missing anti-tilt/captive-fastener or carrier/connector interfaces; they do not clear the existing task.
Independently establish importance and novelty. A named server alone is not evidence of qualifying core work.
